summary: Frontend-only testing for CV. Adi Jaya Gas premium B2B landing page. All 11 sections present, all data-testid attributes functional, all WhatsApp CTAs point to wa.me/62881080590092, form submission opens prefilled WhatsApp URL, sticky navbar/floating WA/mobile sticky CTA bar all work. Two minor design issues detected (6px horizontal overflow at small viewports; literal spaces in contact form WA URL).

integration_issues.issue: buildWaUrl in Contact.jsx uses template literal with raw spaces (e.g. 'Test User') instead of encodeURIComponent. Browsers auto-encode on window.open so wa.me still works, but URL has inconsistent encoding (%0A for newlines, raw spaces for text). Recommend wrapping the message in encodeURIComponent for safety with future special chars (& % # etc.)

issues: Horizontal overflow of ~6px (scrollWidth=396 on 390 viewport, 774 on 768 viewport). Likely from an absolutely-positioned decorative element (e.g. Hero blur/circle, dot-pattern, or a section without overflow-hidden). Causes minor horizontal scroll on touch devices.

action_items: Investigate ~6px horizontal overflow on mobile/tablet (check sections without overflow-hidden or wide absolute decorations).
Optional polish: in /app/frontend/src/components/Contact.jsx buildWaUrl, wrap the constructed message with encodeURIComponent so spaces/special chars are encoded consistently.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx buildWaUrl mixes manual %0A with raw text — should use encodeURIComponent to be safe against future special characters.
All sections, CTAs, and links use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL-rendered URLs correctly; phone numbers and WA links are sourced from /app/frontend/src/lib/constants.js (good DRY).
FloatingWhatsApp uses scroll listener but no throttling; minor perf concern, acceptable for landing page.
Hero section has overflow-hidden but other parents (e.g. body/main) do not — combined with 6px overflow at small widths, this leaks horizontally.
test_credentials: N/A - static landing page, no auth
context_for_next_testing_agent: All critical flows verified end-to-end. Verified: navbar sticky+links, hero CTAs (hero-primary-cta, hero-whatsapp-cta), trust stats (500+, 12+, 8, 20+), 6 product cards (oxygen/nitrogen/argon/co2/helium/specialty) with correct wa.me CTAs, sections #beranda #produk #industri #tentang #kontak all anchor properly, contact info cards (whatsapp/phone/email/address), Google Maps iframe loads from google.com/maps?q=...&output=embed, contact form submit triggers window.open with wa.me URL containing all form fields, floating WhatsApp button shows after scrollY>400 with popup+CTA, mobile sticky bar (telepon + whatsapp), mobile hamburger menu opens with all 5 nav links + CTA, footer present. Console clean - no errors. Only minor: 6px horizontal overflow on mobile/tablet, and form URL has unencoded spaces (still functional).
